claim: In 320x256 or 640x256 Layer 2 the reset clip window (0-255, 0-191) hides the bottom 64 lines until 0-159, 0-255 is written to NextREG 0x18, and the 5-bank picture from bank 8 runs into the default shadow at bank 11.
limit: The clip part seen on a KS1 (core 3.03.00, nxsuite V07); the shadow-bank part is from the book. For double buffering in a wide mode set NextREG 0x13 to bank 13 or higher.

evidence.source: I. Novak, Unraveling the ZX Spectrum Next, Vol 1 (2026; core 3.03.03), chapter 14
evidence.text: Wide-mode clip X is in units of two dots (four in 640x256), so 0-159 spans the width; 256x192 takes 3 banks, the wide modes 5; reset values are active bank 8 and shadow bank 11.
KS1 Issue 2, core 3.03.00 (nxsuite V07): with clip 0-255 / 0-191 only the top of a 320x256 Layer 2 showed; with 0-159 / 0-255 the bottom rows too (operator).
